testCaseName: Verify Location field is visible on Job Seeker profile
Description: Job seeker can see the Location (city) field on the profile page after login.
Test Steps:
1. Login as Job Seeker with valid credentials
2. Navigate to Profile page (/profile)
3. Observe the Location field
Expected result: Profile page opens; Location field (input-location) is visible and editable.

testCaseName: Update city to Mumbai and persist after refresh
Description: Job seeker updates Location to Mumbai (allowed city) and verifies persistence after refresh.
Test Steps:
1. Login as Job Seeker
2. Open Profile page
3. Enter city: Mumbai in Location field
4. Click Save profile
5. Verify success message
6. Refresh the page
7. Check Location field value
Expected result: Profile saved toast is shown; after refresh Location shows Mumbai.

testCaseName: Switch city between Mumbai and Pune
Description: Job seeker changes city from one allowed value to the other and verifies the new value persists.
Test Steps:
1. Login as Job Seeker
2. Open Profile page
3. Note current city (Mumbai or Pune); if neither set to Mumbai first and save
4. Set Location to the other allowed city (Pune if Mumbai else Mumbai)
5. Click Save profile
6. Refresh the page
Expected result: Profile saved; after refresh Location shows the newly selected allowed city only.
